lines.say: Your elevator just grew a new button. Floor minus one.
You've lived on nine for years. The buttons always stopped at one.
You press it. The floor drops. Slow music plays.
The doors open on a long grey office. Clerks. Hundreds of them.
A sign on the wall. Collections. Payments due from the tower.
The man who owns this city pays rent too. To someone down here.
So who do you think owns the tower? Write it in the comments.
